_comment: Single source of truth for output specs. Scripts read ONLY this file - never hardcode specs. Source: Command Center limits confirmed by Sidney, 2026-10-13.
_source: Mission videos: 9:16, >=1080x1920, rec. <=30.0 MB, MP4 H.264 / WebM, <=30s. Mission image: 1:1, >=1024x1024, rec. <=1.0 MB, PNG / JPG / WebP.

feed._evidence: Calibrated against the 27 shipped feed*.mp4 creatives in the reference library (2026-10-13): 30fps unanimous; durations 6.2-30s, median 16.2 (12 of 27 are under 15s, so the old 15s floor was wrong); bitrate median 8676 kbps, max 15094, so the maxrate ceiling is high and enforce_max_size does the real work; sizes 0.3-27.6MB, none over 30MB.

generated._note: Generation happens at 720x1280 (fewer artifacts, fewer credits, PROJECT.md 9.4) but the Command Center requires >=1080x1920, so the export is upscaled. allow_upscale reflects that this is intended, not a quality problem to flag.

mission._note: 1.0 MB is tight: a photographic 1080x1080 PNG routinely lands at 2-3 MB. WebP is in the accepted list and holds that size at visually lossless quality, so it is the default. Set format to png only for flat UI art, or jpg if something downstream rejects WebP.
